service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Beaver Creek
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Beaver Creek's village and on-mountain venues, solo through quartet.

faqs.q: How does gear reach Beano's Cabin or another on-mountain venue?
faqs.a: The way the venue runs its access: by sleigh, snowcat or gondola in winter, by vehicle in summer. We settle the route, the schedule and where cases wait through dinner with the venue in writing before the day, because those answers decide what gear we bring and when it travels. Signet Artists books Beaver Creek retreat evenings from Denver.

faqs.q: How does setup work in the village core?
faqs.a: By dock and service route, on a window the hotel schedules; the escalators are for guests. We measure the distance from the dock to the floor and plan for it. Setup runs 45 to 90 minutes depending on the size of the band, which needs one or two dedicated 20-amp circuits and from about 6 by 4 feet for a solo to 14 by 10 for a quartet. The village sits near 8,100 feet, so we plan a longer sound check, with a retune between sets.

faqs.q: Is there a published noise cap in Beaver Creek?
faqs.a: We haven't confirmed one, and our mountain corridor page says so. Each venue sets its own event rules, so send us the venue name and we'll get the number in writing before the contract. Dinner plays at the level of the conversation either way.
